body:
On the Features tab, move every feature whose state is `complete` or `canceled` into one `Closed` section appended after all milestone groups and the `No milestone` group.

- A closed feature must not also appear under its milestone.
- A feature with no milestone joins the same `Closed` section.
- Closed cards sort by rank then id, matching the order used inside an open group, and keep their existing state, task-count, edit, delete and task-link behavior.
- Show no `Closed` heading when there are no closed features.
- Leave the Roadmap tab's grouping unchanged; it still shows features under their milestones.
- Keep empty milestone groups as they are today.

**Tests:** a complete feature leaves its milestone and appears once under `Closed`; canceled behaves the same; a milestone-less closed feature is included; mixed closed ordering by rank then id; no closed features means no section; all features closed still shows a usable page. Existing grouping and drag tests stay green. **Docs:** describe the `Closed` section in the Strategy README.
title: features: closed records section
